responsibility: Declares default-channel decimal whole-number I/O for INTEGER and CARDINAL values. It is the standard-channel convenience companion to WholeIO, specifying signed and unsigned reads and width-controlled writes using the current default input and output channels.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the SWholeIO pair: it declares the standard-channel INTEGER/CARDINAL whole-number I/O entry points, while SWholeIO.mod implements them as wrappers around WholeIO plus StdChans.
